_comment: Derived-history signals. These are the cheapest, highest-leverage builds we have: nothing new to ingest, just deriving stronger signals from the record HISTORY of data we already pull. A single year of tax delinquency is a signal; three consecutive years with a rising balance is a story (and in NC, foreclosure-eligible). One 311 complaint is noise; five in a year up from one is a property visibly deteriorating. A recorded plat with no houses going up is a stalled subdivision. Tune freely.

tax_staging.note: NC tax foreclosure becomes available ~2yr after delinquency; 3+ consecutive years is foreclosure-ripe

complaint_velocity.note: count in trailing window vs the prior equal window; rising = accelerating deterioration

stalled_subdivision.note: plat recorded but effectively no vertical (building) permits since = a subdivision that stalled after paper approval
